items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I remember when I was with Jazz at the Philharmonic. Well honey, Flip Phillips and Roy and all of us, we were playing cards all over

ctx.x: But like when we would get on the plane or something, we'd sit there and play a little cards. I remember when I was with Jazz at the Philharmonic. Well honey, Flip Phillips and Roy and all of us, we were playing cards all over and then we'd get on the train, you know; well whoever would get on first would go and get the seats and get the table so we could all get together. And we just played cards all over the United States.
How funny. There's a way you can tell something about a guy by the way he plays, isn't there? I mean, not all guys can take to losing, can they?
